visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair stands in a room with a plain off-white wall. She wears a white T-shirt with a California Avocados graphic and pink shorts. She smiles, puts her finger to her chin in a thinking pose, and performs a playful shoulder shrug. The lighting is bright and even. (2) With a quick jump cut, she transforms into a character with a short black bob haircut and a prominent red scarf. She wears a tan military-style jacket over a white shirt. She gazes off-camera with a serious expression, replicating a specific character pose. (3) The scene transitions to clips from an animated series. A male character in green and brown clothing stands on a grassy field under a cloudy sky. Close-up shots show his eyes. Another character with an arm in a sling talks urgently. (4) Back to the cosplayer, now outdoors in a park. She is surrounded by large trees with thick, gnarled roots and green foliage. She holds a long wooden rifle prop, crouching and aiming at various angles. She points toward the distance and speaks. (5) High-quality 3D animations appear, showing characters from the same series flying through a city with mechanical gear. A large, skinless giant (Titan) is shown. The editing is fast, with many cuts showing different costumes and game items like a syringe. (6) The cosplayer returns to the screen, standing by the tree. She holds the rifle across her chest, smiles broadly, and gives a thumbs-up. Text overlays with logos and slogans appear at the bottom and center of the frame as the video ends.

The music continues, and a snippet of Japanese dialogue from an anime is heard, featuring a female voice with a gentle, emotional tone. The background is filled with a subtle wind-like ambient noise. The J-pop music remains steady in the background with consistent intensity and tempo. (4) A male narrator begins speaking Mandarin with high arousal and a professional, excited tone. He describes game features. Interspersed are ding and pop UI sound effects. The spectral brightness increases as synth elements swell in the background music track. (5) The narration continues at a fast speech rate. Sound effects of explosions and lightning-like crackling are heard. The music reaches a crescendo with heavy percussion and distorted guitar riffs. There is a clear speech-music overlap throughout this phase with high energy. (6) The narration concludes with a final call to action. The music fades out slightly, ending with a final percussive beat and a brief electronic chime sound effect. The overall audio quality is compressed and broadcast-ready.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 6th-anniversary collaboration between the mobile game PUBG MOBILE and the anime series Attack on Titan. It uses a high-energy transformation hook to engage the audience, followed by a mix of live-action cosplay and in-game feature demonstrations to build excitement and encourage players to participate in the event.
